mass_channel_reading: the mass function is causal: an outer-level source changes d_mass only above its own radius, so the inner-level fraction is exactly zero. The chart channels (lapse/shift) are the nonlocal influence.
notes: the forward fee is the fraction of an outer-level perturbation's mass response that lands inside the inner quarter of the cap
the backward probe is the reciprocity control; exact reciprocity is not asserted, the two numbers are reported side by side
